mapper.select: SELECT i.total, i.available, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order o WHERE o.campaign_id = i.campaign_id AND o.status = 'PENDING') AS pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order o WHERE o.campaign_id = i.campaign_id AND o.status = 'PAID') AS paid FROM inventory i WHERE i.campaign_id = #{campaignId}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'ORDER_CREATED' AND (o.id IS NULL OR r.order_id IS NULL OR o.id <> r.order_id) THEN 1 END) AS created_without_order, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED') AND o.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS non_created_with_order FROM purchase_request r LEFT JOIN purchase_order o ON o.request_id = r.id WHERE r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND r.status IN ('ORDER_CREATED', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET available = available - 1 WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND available >= 1
